en: See the tree outside with the round fruit? Those are Apricorns.
You'll want something to keep them in. Here, take my old Apricorn Box.
In Azalea Town there's an old man named Kurt who can turn Apricorns into Poké Balls. Every colour makes a ball of its own.
Those Apricorns grow all over Johto. Kurt in Azalea Town will turn them into Poké Balls, you know.
